header.subtitle: Wake-on-Push Whitelist & Blacklist Manager
rom.title: Framework Patch
rom.hint.ok: Patch active: the patched framework matches the running firmware.
rom.hint.pending: Firmware changed: the module stays unmounted and the device runs 100% stock. Re-patch to restore the push fixes.
rom.hint.running: Re-patching: the engine is rebuilding the framework for the new firmware. This takes about a minute.
rom.hint.failed: Re-patch failed: the device is running stock framework. Re-flash the module zip to recover.
rom.hint.reboot: Re-patch done: reboot to mount the newly patched framework.
rom.hint.unavailable: Module state is unavailable (the WebUI root bridge did not answer).
rom.toast.started: Re-patch started, this takes about a minute…
rom.toast.fail: Re-patch failed — check the module log
mode.title: Wake Mode
mode.desc.all: Allow All: All apps receive C2DM wake flag (0x20). Every stopped app wakes on push.
mode.desc.whitelist: Whitelist: ONLY checked apps will wake up and thaw on pushes. Unchecked apps stay strictly stopped.
mode.desc.blacklist: Blacklist: Checked apps are BLOCKED from waking or thawing on pushes. All other apps wake up normally.
modal.help.import: Tap below, long-press to Paste, or type packages (separated by newlines or commas):
sound.title: Sound Anti-Mute
sound.desc: Prevent HyperOS from auto-silencing or throttling notification sound alerts.
sound.feat.miui_cooldown.hint: Disables 10s muting for successive notification bursts
sound.feat.android15_cooldown.hint: Disables politeness and avalanche volume reduction
sound.feat.offbody.hint: Prevents muting when phone is on table or in pocket
sound.feat.group_alert.hint: Bypasses AOSP group muting so email/thread notifications always sound & vibrate
sound.feat.anti_mute_update.hint: Prevents apps from canceling alerts on rapid background updates
sound.feat.unthrottle_alert.hint: Prevents Android from muting consecutive notification chimes ("Muting recently noisy") when multiple messages arrive in rapid succession
sound.toast.restored: Stock sound settings restored from backup ✓
sync.title: Channel Permission Sync
sync.desc: Auto-grant notification permissions to target apps according to your active FCM Wake Mode.
sync.feat.sound.hint: Allow audible ringtone for target channels
sync.feat.vibration.hint: Allow haptic vibration for target channels
sync.feat.lockscreen.hint: Show notifications & wake screen on keyguard
sync.feat.float.hint: Display pop-up banners over running apps
sync.toast.all_up_to_date: All {total} channels are already up to date ✓
parity.title: GMS Global Parity
parity.desc: Enforces Global ROM network and notification behavior on China ROM.
parity.feat.pk.hint: Disarms Netd iptables CHAIN_GMS_WALL & DNS blocker
parity.feat.fsi.hint: Preserves incoming call answer/decline screens when locked
